mil3.1.12:1.3: Upatthambhanalakkhaṇaṃ mahārāja viriyaṃ, viriyūpatthambhitā sabbe kusalā dhammā na parihāyantīti.
mil3.1.12:2.2: Yathā mahārāja puriso gehe patante aññena dārunā upatthambheyya, upatthambhitaṃ santaṃ evan-taṃ gehaṃ na pateyya,
mil3.1.12:2.3: evam eva kho mahārāja upatthambhanalakkhaṇaṃ viriyaṃ, viriyūpatthambhitā sabbe kusalā dhammā na parihāyantīti. -
mil3.1.12:3.2: Yathā mahārāja parittakaṃ senaṃ mahatī senā bhañjeyya, tato rājā aññamaññaṃ anusāreyya anupeseyya, tāya saddhiṃ parittakā senā mahatiṃ senaṃ bhañjeyya,
mil3.1.12:3.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja upatthambhanalakkhaṇaṃ viriyaṃ, viriyūpatthambhitā sabbe kusalā dhammā na parihāyanti.
mil3.1.12:3.5: Viriyavā kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti,
